title: Reading along with each line lit
statement: Whether a text read aloud with each line lit as it is heard, under one fixed play-pause control, helps readers is untested.
detail: A planned stage of the lesson engine reads the text aloud under one play and pause control fixed at the top, with the text moving under it and each line lit as it is heard (`g9/transformer/v07/README.md`). Nothing of it is built, and no lesson has been reviewed by a person or used by a student (`g9/transformer/README.md`).

evidence.quote: - Audio-synced reading: one play and pause control fixed at the top, text moving under it, each line lit as it is
No lesson has been reviewed by a person or used by a student.

Karaoke-style per-word highlighting tested null against no highlighting in children with reading difficulties. This is why audio and synchronized highlighting should be separate decisions rather than one feature.
Do not pair audio with word-by-word highlighting by default. That is a separate decision.
